summary.text: Grand Swine grotto-heaven is a rank eight transformation path grotto-heaven that produces boar type desolate beasts, including immemorial ones.

claims.text: Fang Yuan goes first to Grand Swine grotto-heaven among the two heavens grotto-heavens whose qi harvest fruits are near self-detonation. Under cover of white fog, his Qi Sea clone uses Qi Jue revival to devour that grotto-heaven’s qi harvest fruit for about sixty thousand qi path dao marks. Fang Yuan then annexes Grand Swine grotto-heaven and merges it into Sovereign grotto-heaven. It is a rank eight transformation path grotto-heaven that produces boar type desolate beasts, ancient desolate beasts, and even immemorial desolate beasts. Fang Yuan’s transformation path attainment is at great grandmaster, so he can annex it. He had not annexed it earlier because it had fused with a nine heavens fragment and taken in heaven path dao marks, which invaded the heavenly spirit and left it powerless and dull. Once he can refine heaven path dao marks, grotto-heavens fused with nine heavens fragments become annexable if his attainment in the matching path is sufficient.

Fang Yuan annexes three rank eight grotto-heavens together: transformation path Grand Swine grotto-heaven, time path Time Difference grotto-heaven, and rule path Novelty grotto-heaven. They sit on heaven vein nodes and have been taken care of by heaven’s will for many years. He splits them and places their pieces through the sovereign immortal aperture.

Grand Swine grotto-heaven’s two super resource points are rolling fall cliff and pin tree snowfield. Rolling fall cliff holds desolate beast jumping pigs that jump into a boiling waterfall; survivors break through into ancient desolate beast deadly fat pigs, and the cliff’s yearly deadly fat pig scale is number one in the five regions and two heavens. Pin tree snowfield is home to grand swines, immemorial black pigs as large as mountains with black bones and slow movement. Fang Yuan places pin tree snowfield in Mini Northern Plains, expanding that area by twenty percent, with over five hundred grand swines of all sizes and ages.
Related resource-site detail sits on Rolling fall cliff.

Annexing Grand Swine, Novelty, and Time Difference and refining their heaven path dao marks lets Fang Yuan meet the lowest requirement for refining Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool. Each of those grotto-heavens had merged with a nine heavens fragment. Grand Swine grotto-heaven has the most dao marks among the three: over three million and two hundred thousand transformation path dao marks and over three thousand three hundred heaven path dao marks.
After Fang Yuan annexes Grand Swine grotto-heaven and Time Difference grotto-heaven, he does not stop annexing other grotto-heavens. The subdued variant human alliance can only watch.
